audience: community and support teams that run a Discord server with a bot

useCases.title: Read recent messages in a channel
useCases.text: List the recent messages of a channel, newest first, and open one message. Message text is empty unless the bot has the message content intent.

useCases.title: Map servers and channels
useCases.text: List the servers the bot is in, then the channels of one server. Read the type, topic and parent of one channel.

useCases.title: Read pinned messages
useCases.text: List the pinned messages of a channel, with the time each one was pinned.

useCases.title: Look up a public user profile
useCases.text: Read the public profile of a user by id: username, global name, avatar and bot flag. No private data is returned.

useCases.title: Post a message as the bot
useCases.text: Post a text message to a channel, or reply to a message in the same channel. Mentions do not ping everyone or roles.
